description: This file defines the main SwiftUI view for the ReAct Agent demo, including the ContentView and StepView components that manage user interaction and display of the agent's steps and status.

classes.name: ContentView
classes.description: Main SwiftUI view managing the overall layout, user inputs, and displaying the list of agent steps.

classes.name: StepView
classes.description: View for rendering individual steps within the agent's process, showing icons, timestamps, and content.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Constructs the main user interface for ContentView, including input fields, buttons, and lists of steps.

methods.name: getStepColor
methods.description: Returns the color associated with a step type, used for styling.

methods.name: getStepIcon
methods.description: Returns the system icon name based on the step type.

methods.name: getStepTitle
methods.description: Provides a title string for different step types.

methods.name: formatTime
methods.description: Formats Date objects into time string for display.
